info.title: Shipmondo API
info.description:
This is the official API for Shipmondo. The current version is v3.
The Shipmondo API is documented using OpenAPI. You can find the OpenAPI spec here: https://app.shipmondo.com/api/public/v3/openapi.json


We recommend that new implementations should be based on this version.


We provide an official library for PHP, which you can find here: https://github.com/shipmondo/shipmondo_php_sdk


If you need further assistance for your implementation, feel free to contact us at support@shipmondo.com

get.description:
Returns a list of the available and nearest pickup points based on input.


Usually the address information given should be the receivers address to find pickup points nearest their location.


The identification of the pickup points can be used/required when creating a shipment.

parameters.name: carrier_code
parameters.description: Carrier code to be included in the filter.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: Country code (ISO Alpha-2) to be included in the filter.

parameters.name: zipcode
parameters.description: Zip code / Postal code.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Name of the city. It is recommended to include city with the request to increase the hit accuracy.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Street address (contains street name and house number)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the pickup point. Used to look up a specific service point for a carrier. When used, zip code is no longer required. Some carrier may not support this parameter.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Defines how many pickup points are being returned.

parameters.name: collect_points
parameters.description: Set as true to get collect points for products like GLS Click&Collect

parameters.name: product_code
parameters.description: Used to, e.g., determine whether to return postfiliale (default) or packstations for DHL Parcel.

parameters.name: in_delivery
parameters.description: Filter on whether or not the pickup point supports drop-off of parcels.

parameters.name: out_delivery
parameters.description: Filter on whether or not the pickup point supports pickup of parcels.

get.description:
Returns a list of sales orders.


Sales orders are used handle all processes of the order flow, including but not limited to picking, packing, sending shipments, and capturing payments through the Shipmondo app.

parameters.description: ID for the sales order to be included in the filter.

parameters.name: order_id

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: reference for the order to be included in the filter.

parameters.name: bill_to_email
parameters.description: Billing email for the order to be included in the filter.

parameters.name: bill_to_mobile
parameters.description: Billing mobile for the order to be included in the filter.

parameters.name: ship_to_email
parameters.description: Shipping email for the order to be included in the filter.

parameters.name: ship_to_mobile
parameters.description: Shipping mobile for the order to be included in the filter.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Filter for archived or not.

parameters.name: created_at_min
parameters.description:
"From" value of "created" timestamp for the sales orders to be included in the filter. Examples:
* 2018-06-19T11:00:03.305+02:00
* 2018-06-19 will be transformed into 2017-06-19T00:00:00.000+02:00

* 2018-06-29T11:00:03.305+02:00
* 2018-06-29 will be transformed into 2017-06-29T00:00:00.000+02:00

parameters.name: updated_at_min

"From" value of "updated" timestamp for the sales orders to be included in the filter. Examples:
* 2018-06-19T11:00:03.305+02:00
* 2018-06-19 will be transformed into 2017-06-19T00:00:00.000+02:00

parameters.name: updated_at_max
parameters.description:
"To" value of "updated" timestamp for the sales orders to be included in the filter. Examples:
* 2018-06-29T11:00:03.305+02:00
* 2018-06-29 will be transformed into 2017-06-29T00:00:00.000+02:00

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: For pagination. Defines how many entries are returned per page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: For pagination. Defines which page the results are fetched from.

post.description:
Creates a new webhook with the specified information and activates it.



      
Webhooks create an event when an action that is subscribed to is performed in Shipmondo. The event is then sent to the specified endpoint containing the current data of the affected object.


      Endpoint must be set up to receive messages before creating the webhook.


      Accepted values for action depends on the resource_name used.


      Available actions for [**Shipments**](shipment_get) resource:

      - create

      - cancel


      Available actions for [**Orders**](sales_order_get) resource:

      - create

      - status_update

      - create_fulfillment

      - create_shipment

      - payment_captured

      - payment_voided

      - delete


      Available actions for [**Drafts**](draft_shipment_get) (Draft shipments) resource:

      - create

      - create_shipment

      - delete


      Available actions for **Shipment Monitor** resource:

      - latest

      - delivered

attributes.description: Attributes for the party. Used for additional information about the party.

name.description: Name of the receiver. Can be either a company name or the name of a private person.

attention.description: Attention of the receiver. If the receiver is a company, it is the contact person.

address1.description: Address of the receiver, including address number.

address2.description: Second address line of the receiver. Can be used for floor/room number, building name etc.

city.description: Name of the city that the zip code refers to.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the receiver.

vat_id.description: Sender's VAT ID in receiver country.

telephone.description: Landline phone number of the receiver

instruction.description: Delivery instruction to the carrier. Only applicable for products which support receiver instructions.

access_code.description: Gate/door code for the carrier to access the receiver's address.

from_time.description: Requested earliest delivery time. Format HH:MM

to_time.description: Requested latest delivery time. Format HH:MM

member_id.description: Carrier member ID. Some products support/require this; e.g., DHL Parcel shipments to Packstations (DHL PostNumber).

name.description: Name of the sender. Can be either a company name or the name of a private person.

attention.description: Attention of the sender. If the sender is a company, it is the contact person.

address1.description: Address of the sender, including address number.

address2.description: Second address line of the sender. Can be used for floor/room number, building name etc.

city.description: Name of the city that the zip code refers to.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the sender address.

vat_id.description: Sender's VAT ID in receiver country, e.g., VOEC for Norway or GB EORI for Great Britain.

telephone.description: Landline phone number of the sender

address1.description: Address line 1 of the service point.

address2.description: Second address line can be used for floor/room number, building name etc.

zipcode.description: Zip code of the service point.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the service point.

shipping_agent.description: Carrier code of the carrier that the service point belongs to.

endpoint.description: Endpoint the webhook sends request to.

active.description: Indicates if the webhook is active.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime the object was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the object was updated.

action.description: The action that webhook is hooked to.

resource_name.description: The name of the resource that webhook is hooked to.

endpoint.description: Endpoint the webhook sends request to.

key.description: Encryption key that should encrypt and decrypt the webhook message with JWT.

resource_name.description: The name of the resource that webhook is hooked to.
